# v2.63-dev Release Notes

## New: see every eligible candidate, not just the recommended few

On **Programs › Compliance Planning**, the roadmap tells you a requirement has,
say, "24 easy" candidates, but "Who to certify" only lists the cheapest subset the
plan nominates to close the gap. There was no way to see the rest.

A new **"All eligible candidates"** section now appears below "Who to certify",
listing the **full pool** — everyone who already holds qualifying training and could
be certified, deduped across the whole plan. It has the same columns, plain-language
drill-down, sorting, and CSV/Excel/PDF export as "Who to certify", and it's included
in the whole-page **Export report**.

Use it to pick alternatives — for example, when the cheapest recommended person
isn't the one you want to move (wrong country, availability, etc.), you can see
everyone else who could close the same gap.
